# The element-wise loop runs four vectors per iteration, then single vectors, then
# one partial vector, and a reduction runs four accumulators. Every size from 0 to
# 300, and byte loops past four 64-lane vectors, goes through each part on every
# target, for a body of two statements with a temporary, an if chain, a read ahead
# of the stored slice, and integer reductions, which wrap. Both builds print the
# same checksums.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

// Two statements and a temporary.
func Mix(dst, a, b []int32, k int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := a[i]*k + b[i]
		dst[i] = t ^ (t >> 3)
	}
}

// An if chain that clamps a temporary.
func Clamp(dst, a []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		v := a[i]
		if v < lo {
			v = lo
		} else if v > hi {
			v = hi
		}
		dst[i] = v
	}
}

// Reads two elements ahead of the slice it stores.
func Ahead(a, b []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(a)-2; i++ {
		a[i] = a[i+2] - b[i]
	}
}

// Bytes: 64 lanes on AVX-512.
func XorAdd(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = (a[i] ^ b[i]) + a[i]
	}
}

// Integer reductions, which wrap.
func SumBytes(a []uint8) uint8 {
	var s uint8
	for i := range a {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func XorHalves(a []uint16) uint16 {
	var x uint16
	for i := range a {
		x ^= a[i]
	}
	return x
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

// Two statements and a temporary.
func Mix(dst, a, b []int32, k int32) {
	_vcInt32s0_1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(k)
	if _loopvecOverlap(a, dst, 0, len(a), 0, len(dst)) || _loopvecOverlap(b, dst, 0, len(b), 0, len(dst)) {
		for i := range dst {
			t := a[i]*k + b[i]
			dst[i] = t ^ (t >> 3)
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := a[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := b[:_count:_count], dst[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_t1 := _v1.Mul(_vcInt32s0_1).Add(_v2)
					_t1.ShiftAllRight(uint64(3)).Xor(_t1).Store(_c3)
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_t2 := _v3.Mul(_vcInt32s0_1).Add(_v4)
					_t2.ShiftAllRight(uint64(3)).Xor(_t2).Store(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_t3 := _v5.Mul(_vcInt32s0_1).Add(_v6)
					_t3.ShiftAllRight(uint64(3)).Xor(_t3).Store(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_t4 := _v7.Mul(_vcInt32s0_1).Add(_v8)
					_t4.ShiftAllRight(uint64(3)).Xor(_t4).Store(_c3[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w1[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_t5 := _v9.Mul(_vcInt32s0_1).Add(_v10)
					_t5.ShiftAllRight(uint64(3)).Xor(_t5).Store(_w3[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w1[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_t6 := _v11.Mul(_vcInt32s0_1).Add(_v12)
					_t6.ShiftAllRight(uint64(3)).Xor(_t6).StorePart(_w3[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// An if chain that clamps a temporary.
func Clamp(dst, a []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	_vcFloat32s1_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(lo)
	_vcFloat32s1_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(hi)
	if _loopvecOverlap(a, dst, 0, len(a), 0, len(dst)) {
		for i := range dst {
			v := a[i]
			if v < lo {
				v = lo
			} else if v > hi {
				v = hi
			}
			dst[i] = v
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := a[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := dst[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1)
					_t1 := _v1
					_t2 := _vcFloat32s1_1.IfElse(_t1.Less(_vcFloat32s1_1), _vcFloat32s1_3.IfElse(_t1.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_3), _t1))
					_t2.Store(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1[_lanes:])
					_t3 := _v2
					_t4 := _vcFloat32s1_1.IfElse(_t3.Less(_vcFloat32s1_1), _vcFloat32s1_3.IfElse(_t3.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_3), _t3))
					_t4.Store(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_t5 := _v3
					_t6 := _vcFloat32s1_1.IfElse(_t5.Less(_vcFloat32s1_1), _vcFloat32s1_3.IfElse(_t5.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_3), _t5))
					_t6.Store(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
					_t7 := _v4
					_t8 := _vcFloat32s1_1.IfElse(_t7.Less(_vcFloat32s1_1), _vcFloat32s1_3.IfElse(_t7.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_3), _t7))
					_t8.Store(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w1[_i:])
					_t9 := _v5
					_t10 := _vcFloat32s1_1.IfElse(_t9.Less(_vcFloat32s1_1), _vcFloat32s1_3.IfElse(_t9.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_3), _t9))
					_t10.Store(_w2[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w1[_i:])
					_t11 := _v6
					_t12 := _vcFloat32s1_1.IfElse(_t11.Less(_vcFloat32s1_1), _vcFloat32s1_3.IfElse(_t11.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_3), _t11))
					_t12.StorePart(_w2[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// Reads two elements ahead of the slice it stores.
func Ahead(a, b []int32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(a, b, 0, len(a)-2+2, 0, len(a)-2) {
		for i := 0; i < len(a)-2; i++ {
			a[i] = a[i+2] - b[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(a)-2 > 0 {
			_ = a[(len(a)-2)-1]
			_ = a[(len(a)-2)+1]
			_ = b[(len(a)-2)-1]
			{
				_w1 := a[:(len(a) - 2):(len(a) - 2)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := a[2:][:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3)
					_v1.Sub(_v2).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v3.Sub(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.Sub(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.Sub(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w3[_i:])
					_v9.Sub(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v11.Sub(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// Bytes: 64 lanes on AVX-512.
func XorAdd(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, len(dst), 0, len(b)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = (a[i] ^ b[i]) + a[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint8s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c3)
					_v1.Xor(_v2).Add(_v1).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v3.Xor(_v4).Add(_v3).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.Xor(_v6).Add(_v5).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.Xor(_v8).Add(_v7).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadUint8s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadUint8s(_w3[_i:])
					_v9.Xor(_v10).Add(_v9).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadUint8sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadUint8sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v11.Xor(_v12).Add(_v11).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// Integer reductions, which wrap.
func SumBytes(a []uint8) uint8 {
	var s uint8
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 256 {
			_a1_0 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(0)
			_a1_1 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(0)
			_a1_2 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(0)
			_a1_3 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(0)
			_lanes := _a1_0.Len()
			for ; _i <= len(a)-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadUint8s(a[_i:])
				_a1_0 = _a1_0.Add(_v1)
				_v2 := simd.LoadUint8s(a[_i+_lanes:])
				_a1_1 = _a1_1.Add(_v2)
				_v3 := simd.LoadUint8s(a[_i+2*_lanes:])
				_a1_2 = _a1_2.Add(_v3)
				_v4 := simd.LoadUint8s(a[_i+3*_lanes:])
				_a1_3 = _a1_3.Add(_v4)
			}
			for ; _i <= len(a)-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v5 := simd.LoadUint8s(a[_i:])
				_a1_0 = _a1_0.Add(_v5)
			}
			_a1_0 = _a1_0.Add(_a1_1)
			_a1_0 = _a1_0.Add(_a1_2)
			_a1_0 = _a1_0.Add(_a1_3)
			var _buf1 [64]uint8
			_a1_0.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				s = s + _x
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			s += a[i]
		}
	}
	return s
}

func XorHalves(a []uint16) uint16 {
	var x uint16
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 128 {
			_a1_0 := simd.BroadcastUint16s(0)
			_a1_1 := simd.BroadcastUint16s(0)
			_a1_2 := simd.BroadcastUint16s(0)
			_a1_3 := simd.BroadcastUint16s(0)
			_lanes := _a1_0.Len()
			for ; _i <= len(a)-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadUint16s(a[_i:])
				_a1_0 = _a1_0.Xor(_v1)
				_v2 := simd.LoadUint16s(a[_i+_lanes:])
				_a1_1 = _a1_1.Xor(_v2)
				_v3 := simd.LoadUint16s(a[_i+2*_lanes:])
				_a1_2 = _a1_2.Xor(_v3)
				_v4 := simd.LoadUint16s(a[_i+3*_lanes:])
				_a1_3 = _a1_3.Xor(_v4)
			}
			for ; _i <= len(a)-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v5 := simd.LoadUint16s(a[_i:])
				_a1_0 = _a1_0.Xor(_v5)
			}
			_a1_0 = _a1_0.Xor(_a1_1)
			_a1_0 = _a1_0.Xor(_a1_2)
			_a1_0 = _a1_0.Xor(_a1_3)
			var _buf1 [32]uint16
			_a1_0.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				x = x ^ _x
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			x ^= a[i]
		}
	}
	return x
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

// Two statements and a temporary.
func Mix(dst, a, b []int32, k int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := a[i]*k + b[i]
		dst[i] = t ^ (t >> 3)
	}
}

// An if chain that clamps a temporary.
func Clamp(dst, a []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		v := a[i]
		if v < lo {
			v = lo
		} else if v > hi {
			v = hi
		}
		dst[i] = v
	}
}

// Reads two elements ahead of the slice it stores.
func Ahead(a, b []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(a)-2; i++ {
		a[i] = a[i+2] - b[i]
	}
}

// Bytes: 64 lanes on AVX-512.
func XorAdd(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = (a[i] ^ b[i]) + a[i]
	}
}

// Integer reductions, which wrap.
func SumBytes(a []uint8) uint8 {
	var s uint8
	for i := range a {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func XorHalves(a []uint16) uint16 {
	var x uint16
	for i := range a {
		x ^= a[i]
	}
	return x
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 6 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"math"

	"example.com/test"
)

func sizes() []int {
	var s []int
	for n := 0; n <= 300; n++ {
		s = append(s, n)
	}
	return append(s, 511, 512, 513, 600, 1031)
}

func sum32(s []int32) uint64 {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	for _, v := range s {
		fmt.Fprint(h, v, ",")
	}
	return h.Sum64()
}

func sumF(s []float32) uint64 {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	for _, v := range s {
		fmt.Fprint(h, math.Float32bits(v), ",")
	}
	return h.Sum64()
}

func sum8(s []uint8) uint64 {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	h.Write(s)
	return h.Sum64()
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range sizes() {
		a, b, d := make([]int32, n), make([]int32, n), make([]int32, n)
		f, g := make([]float32, n), make([]float32, n)
		x, y, z := make([]uint8, n), make([]uint8, n), make([]uint8, n)
		u := make([]uint16, n)
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			a[i] = int32(i*7919%1000) - 500
			b[i] = int32(i*31%97) - 40
			f[i] = float32(i%17) - 8.5
			x[i], y[i] = uint8(i*13), uint8(i*29+7)
			u[i] = uint16(i * 40503)
		}
		test.Mix(d, a, b, 3)
		test.Clamp(g, f, -4, 5.25)
		h := append([]int32(nil), a...)
		test.Ahead(h, b)
		test.XorAdd(z, x, y)
		fmt.Println(n, sum32(d), sumF(g), sum32(h), sum8(z), test.SumBytes(x), test.XorHalves(u))
	}
}
